task_text: Assign four civilian workshop tasks T0,T1,T2,T3 to five workers W0,W1,W2,W3,W4. Each task must be assigned to exactly one worker. Each worker can perform at most one task; one worker may remain idle. The cost matrix, with rows W0 to W4 and columns T0 to T3, is [[90,80,75,70],[35,85,55,65],[125,95,90,95],[45,110,95,115],[50,100,90,100]]. Minimize total assignment cost.
supplement: This English statement is a demo paraphrase of the official tutorial, not a quoted benchmark record. Assignments are binary. Keep task identifiers T0,T1,T2,T3 and worker order. Quantity unit: assignments. Objective unit: cost_units.

rules: problem_type: assignment for workers/tasks, otherwise linear for production/advertising.
objective: minimize or maximize; entities are identifier strings.
Assignment: tasks are identifiers; cost_matrix rows follow entities and columns follow tasks.
Linear: each constraint is {name: string, coefficients: number array, sense: <= or >= or =, rhs: number, unit: string}.
Linear: all vectors follow entities; use null for an absent upper bound; variable_type is integer or continuous.
